InclusionIndicator.name: Inclusion Indicator
InclusionIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the referred strategy is included.

MinimumInvestmentAmount.name: Minimum Investment Amount
MinimumInvestmentAmount.definition: Minimum amount that has to be invested in the specified strategy.

MinimumInvestmentRate.name: Minimum Investment Rate
MinimumInvestmentRate.definition: Minimum percentage that has to be invested in the specified strategy.

MaximumInvestmentAmount.name: Maximum Investment Amount
MaximumInvestmentAmount.definition: Maximum amount that may be invested in the specified strategy.

MaximumInvestmentRate.name: Maximum Investment Rate
MaximumInvestmentRate.definition: Maximum percentage that may be invested in the specified strategy.

EffectivePeriod.name: Effective Period
EffectivePeriod.definition: Period during which the investment guideline is valid.

DistributionPolicy.name: Distribution Policy
DistributionPolicy.definition: Income policy relating to the fund, ie, if income is paid out or retained in the fund.

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: Free text description of the investment guideline, for example, rating requirements.

Portfolio.name: Portfolio
Portfolio.definition: Portfolio for which a strategy is specified.
